title: fix(rest): the dataset query door judges admission on the refusal arm before it names holders (ADR-0150 D3 after ADR-0149 D2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuLPBRvpeugFUfuqRnBTBn8n)_

Fixes #32292 (limb 1. Limb 2 is withdrawn as not reproduced by the seat ruling 6817809380, Q3 = A; its census is under Acceptance notes, with no code change.)

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`POST /analytics/dataset/query`（含批量接口的每一条查询）按名字读数据集被拒（同名有多个持有包）时，先判调用者能查哪些持有包，再作答。不能查的包不算候选，也不会在回答里出现。
- 为什么改：调用者不该从拒绝信息里得知自己看不到的数据集属于哪个包。MCP 工具 `query_dataset` 早已是"先判准入再按包解析"，REST 门现在与它一致（ADR-0150 D3 在 ADR-0149 D2 之后）。
- 风险与回滚：只动"按名读被拒"这一支；按名读能解析出唯一项的回答一律不变，包括单一持有包时查询自身给出的 403。准入无法判定且可能改变答案时答 503、什么都不跑。回滚即 revert 本 PR，对外只回到旧的"409 列出全部持有包"。
- 先看：`packages/rest/src/analytics-dataset-admission-order.ts`（规则本体）；`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.ts` 里 `answerDatasetQuery` 的 catch 分支（只在拒绝时调用规则）；`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.test.ts` 末尾的 `[#32292]` 一组钉子。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/analytics-routes.test.ts -t '#32292'`，预期 14 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`POST /analytics/dataset/query` resolved the saved dataset's name through the protocol's by-name read first, and judged the caller's admission only inside `queryDataset`. So when two packages held the name, a caller admitted to neither got `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both. MCP `query_dataset` admits first and then applies D3 over the admitted holders (epic ruling 6766102988, point 1).

Now, when the by-name read **refuses** the name (bare read, `?callerPackage=`, or `?package=` naming a package that does not hold it), the door reads each refused holder's item at its exact `?package=` address and asks `admitDatasetCatalogEntry` (the analytics service's plugin-wired admission) which ones this caller may query. The rule lives in the new module `analytics-dataset-admission-order.ts` (`admitRefusedDatasetHolders`). The batch door answers each query through the same `answerDatasetQuery`, so it moves the same way.

Moved answers (Clause-② arm `yes (widening)`, as ruled in 6817809380; the visibility half is ADR-0149 D2), for a caller admitted to fewer holders than the name has:

| Case | FROM | TO |
|---|---|---|
| Admitted to none of the refused holders | `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming every holder | `404 NOT_FOUND`, byte-equal to the answer for a name nothing holds |
| An ambiguity (`ambiguous-in-environment`, `-in-closure`, `-in-namespace`) with exactly one holder admitted | `409` naming every holder | `200`, that holder's dataset runs |
| Two or more admitted, or a non-ambiguity refusal (`outside-closure`, `not-held-by-qualifier`) with any admitted | `409` naming every holder | `409` naming only the admitted holders |
| A holder whose admission cannot be judged, where it could change the answer | `409` naming every holder | `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, nothing run, no holder named |

Not moved:

- A name the by-name read **resolves** keeps its answer. One holder, the caller package's own item, its one closure item, or an exact `?package=` hit runs into `queryDataset`'s own gates, so a caller not admitted to it still gets their `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`. Seat ruling Q1 = A: moving admission ahead of every read would turn every dashboard's `403` into `404`, which this card does not ask for.
- When the caller arm resolves to the caller package's own item or its one closure item and admission refuses, that answer stands. It never falls through to another package's dataset of the same name (Q2 = A).
- A service whose admission is not the plugin-wired set (`hasPluginWiredAdmission()` false: a hand-built service admits everyone) is not asked, so its refusal still names every holder.
- A refusal that names the environment or the platform as a candidate is answered as it is (no dataset sits beside a package holder there).

The epic scope note 6781265442 asked for the `?callerPackage=` arm to move too and to be pinned there as well as on the bare read and `?package=`. All three arms are pinned below.

## Tests

`packages/rest/src/analytics-routes.test.ts`, the `[#32292]` describe: 14 cases over the real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` and `SchemaRegistry`, with an analytics double whose admission admits by the dataset's object (as the real one judges the object read grant) and whose `queryDataset` throws the real `PERMISSION_DENIED` / 403 envelope where a pin needs the query gates. 11 cases came with b60e9776a; this round adds 3 (890be0cd1): the Q1 403 pin, the Q2 closure-item pin, and the caller arm's three-holder refusal.

Measured red/green on head `890be0cd1` (main `2f80f2897` merged at `7499b616a`). Each leg mutates through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which proves the mutation on disk (anchor count 1 → 0, blob moved) and the restore (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). `packages/rest` tests import the door and the rule from source, so no rebuild is needed between legs.

- A0, main's door: in `analytics-routes.ts`, the refusal is rethrown before the rule runs (marker `ABLATE_32292_RETHROW`). This is the answer main gives.
- A1, `analytics-dataset-admission-order.ts`: the narrowed refusal keeps every package candidate (marker `ABLATE_32292_ALL`).
- A2, same file: the `503` arm is removed (marker `ABLATE_32292_NO503`).
- A3, same file: an ambiguity with one admitted holder is not picked (marker `ABLATE_32292_NOPICK`).

| Pin | HEAD | A0 | A1 | A2 | A3 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| admitted to neither holder: 404, byte-equal to a missing name | green | **red** | green | green | green |
| admitted to exactly one of two holders: that one runs, either order | green | **red** | green | green | **red** |
| admitted to two of three: 409 naming only those two | green | **red** | **red** | green | green |
| CONTROL: admitted to both: 409 naming both | green | green | green | green | green |
| caller arm, two closure holders: none → 404, one → runs | green | **red** | green | green | **red** |
| outside the closure, and `?package=` naming a non-holder: 409 naming only the admitted, none → 404 | green | **red** | **red** | green | green |
| admission undetermined where it moves the answer: 503 | green | **red** | green | **red** | green |
| CONTROL: a name the read resolves: admission not asked | green | green | green | green | green |
| CONTROL: caller arm resolved to P's own item never falls through (Q2) | green | green | green | green | green |
| CONTROL (new): one holder not admitted keeps queryDataset's 403 (Q1) | green | green | green | green | green |
| CONTROL (new): caller arm's one closure item keeps its 403, never the holder outside (Q2) | green | green | green | green | green |
| caller arm (new), three closure holders, two admitted: 409 naming only those two | green | **red** | **red** | green | green |
| CONTROL: a service without plugin-wired admission is not asked | green | green | green | green | green |
| batch door: each query judged the same way; a hidden entry byte-equal to a missing one | green | **red** | green | green | **red** |
| **Totals** | 14/14 | 8 red | 3 red | 1 red | 3 red |

Every negative pin goes red under A0, and each targeted leg reds only the pins of its own arm. Every control stays green on every leg.

A fifth leg puts `origin/main`'s own `analytics-routes.ts` blob (`8a88b63d`) under this head's tests: the same 8 pins red and the same 6 green as A0. It was restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH` and the blob checked equal to HEAD's (`77cd4831`).

## Acceptance notes

- **Limb 2 census (withdrawn, Q3 = A), re-read on this head:** the served-list doors that keep one row per holder are `savedHoldersOf` in `packages/services/service-analytics/src/dataset-tools.ts` (around line 267, the dataset tools), and `listSkillPrompts` / the face resolution in `packages/mcp/src/skill-prompts.ts` (around lines 167 and 247, skill `prompts/get`). Both take the first row of one merged list, which carries one overlaid row per package, and the stdio fallback lists no package dataset rows, so no host in the tree feeds them two rows of one package: no reach. The agent roster `readAgentRoster` in `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts` (around line 1131) lists every row and picks none. No code change.
- **Arm reading for the reviewer:** the declaration follows the seat ruling (`yes (widening)`). The `409 → 404` row moves one refusal to another, which ADR-0149 D2 asks for (hidden and missing are one answer). Where a `409` stays, it now names only the holders the caller may query; its status and `code` do not change. The `409 → 200` row is the widening.
- **Branch name:** `claude/project-thread-elxrlt` is the card thread's harness-pinned branch (claim 6817615501), a platform exception to `claude/issue-N-slug`.
- **History:** developed on the blocker head `claude/project-thread-phk4r9` and kept there until PR #32497 landed (`0763bf6ec`). Main `2f80f2897` is merged in at `7499b616a`, never rebased. All ten files `git show --remerge-diff` lists (`.changeset/32183-disabled-package-holds-no-name.md`, `stored-package-references.literal-namespace.test.ts`, core `security-catalog.ts` and its test, `stored-permission-set-package-backfill.test.ts`, `meta-qualified-item-route.test.ts`, runtime `automation-address.ts` and `meta-qualified-item-read.test.ts`, service-automation `engine.ts` and `stored-reference-package-column.test.ts`) belong to #32497, and each one's merged blob equals `origin/main`'s. After the merge, `git diff origin/main...HEAD` is this card's four files only.

## Verification

All readings are on head `890be0cd1`, the tree this PR opens with.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: exit 0, 407 files, 8124 passed, 332 skipped. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test:repo`: exit 0, 5 files, 300 passed, 23 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0, 0 debt entries.
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 65 commands for the 4 changed paths (584 changed lines, under the 3000 threshold). All 65 exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 65 derived, 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Two answered exit 3 (a prerequisite, not a verdict) on the first pass and exit 0 on rerun: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` after fetching its pinned fixture commit (shallow clone), and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` after a full `pnpm build` (119/119 tasks), with 123 entry points across 72 packages loading. The ADR-0087 registration gate (`--base origin/main` and `--self-test`) and the changeset gates (`check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`) are in the 65.
- Full dogfood battery: not run. The title carries no `!` and the Clause-② arm is `(widening)`.
